sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United, currently top with 22 points from 10 games, travel away to face Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. Sandbach have won seven of their ten matches so far, though they suffered a loss in their most recent outing; they'll be looking to bounce back against an Alsager side struggling near the foot of the table with just four points from ten games.
divisionWide: The chasing pack will be keen to capitalize on any slip-ups from Sandbach this weekend. Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town on Saturday; Stafford themselves are in mixed recent form with a loss sandwiched between wins and draws. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth travel to Eccleshall in a fixture between two teams in the upper reaches of the table—Eccleshall currently sit fifth while AFC Bridgnorth are third, making this a significant clash. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth in the table, face Wednesfield Community at home, while Bilston Town (sixth) host Foley Meir in a mid-table encounter. Barnton travel to Shawbury United, a side struggling with five consecutive losses. New Mills face Market Drayton Town away, with both teams mid-table but seeking consistency. Crewe host Allscott Heath in a fixture between two sides in the lower half, while Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a battle between two of the division's poorest-performing teams. Widnes Town, pointless near the bottom, visit Brereton Social at home in another fixture involving struggling clubs. A midweek fixture sees Brereton Social face Wednesfield Community at home on Wednesday evening at 19:45.
